mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sre_incident WHERE state NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')) AS open_incidents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sre_outbox_event WHERE state IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')) AS outbox_backlog, COALESCE((SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(create_time), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM sre_outbox_event WHERE state = 'PENDING'), 0) AS outbox_oldest_age_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sre_rca_evaluation_run WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')) AS evaluation_backlog, COALESCE((SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(create_time), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM sre_rca_evaluation_run WHERE status = 'QUEUED'), 0) AS evaluation_oldest_age_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sre_investigation_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING') AS active_investigations
